t: This is the Inner Temple, one of the four Inns of Court. It is a professional association for barristers and judges, and to be called to the Bar and practise as a barrister in England and Wales, a person must belong to one of these Inns. It sits in the wider Temple area, near the Royal Courts of Justice, within the City of London. As a liberty, it functions largely as an independent local authority. John Lamotte Honywood, an Essex Member of Parliament, lived here, and the barrister James Boswell the younger died here.
